qr.title: Patient ID QR
qr.redirectHint: QR codes live on the back of your Patient ID card on the Me tab.

share.title: Emergency details
share.help: Shared via CareMate Patient ID QR. Only a signed-in health practitioner can view these emergency details and ICE contacts.
share.noProfileYet: This CareMate ID has no emergency profile yet.
share.invalidMessage: This emergency share link is not valid.
share.notFoundMessage: No emergency share matches this code.
share.errorMessage: Check your connection and try again.
share.practitionerRequiredMessage: Medical emergency details from a Patient ID QR are only available to signed-in health practitioners. Turn on “I am a health practitioner” in your profile, then scan again.

lock.title: Emergency card
lock.retiredHelp: Emergency details stay in the CareMate app. Share them with your Patient ID QR card.
lock.retiredBody: Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets no longer show health information. Generate a Patient ID on the Me tab — the QR on the back opens CareMate for signed-in health practitioners.
lock.help: Show this card if you cannot speak for yourself.
lock.widgetIos: Add the CareMate “Emergency Info” widget to your Lock Screen (long-press Lock Screen → Customize → Add Widget).
lock.widgetAndroid: Add the CareMate “Emergency Info” widget to your Home Screen (long-press home → Widgets).
lock.minimalFields: Minimal fields shown: name, blood group, genotype, allergies, and your first ICE contact.
lock.noProfileMessage: Open CareMate and create an Emergency Health Profile.
lock.footnoteIos: Use your Patient ID QR instead of lock-screen widgets.
lock.footnoteAndroid: Use your Patient ID QR instead of home-screen widgets.
